India Hosts First BIMSTEC Home Ministers Meeting

India is hosting the first-ever BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) Home Ministers meeting in New Delhi on Tuesday, October 13. The meeting aims to enhance cooperation among the member states. However, the Home Minister of Bangladesh will not be attending the event.
